review_note: Reviewed 7b80d088: private staged-cancellation and managed birth-decision observation APIs preserve execution-domain deadlines and exact namespace, request and owner bindings. Root cancellation precedes namespace cleanup; operation and owned-child fences prevent delayed admission while reserved identity and capacity debt remain. Historical completion cannot clear newer selected work. Generic opaque catalog rows remain valid; typed before/after history projections preserve group fences. The codec and fleet architecture excerpts are unchanged; their whole-file hashes and source lines were reviewed after partition-cancellation-1. Other anchors are unchanged from 032a8962. The protocol requires fresh namespaces, fleet roots and engine directories with matching binaries, with numeric markers at 1. Tests use the existing resource, compiler, stack and deadline bounds. An unselected reservation is not materializable: fixtures independently inspect the immutable birth winner and verify an unrelated operation can still perform a fresh root update.
